lines.speaker: copycat
lines.text: It's getting hard to breathe. Shouldn't we tell someone?
lines.say: It's getting hard to breathe... Shouldn't we tell someone?

lines.speaker: cheat
lines.text: Relax. If it was dangerous, somebody would say so.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: Now he has said it is fine. Leaving would mean admitting he was *wrong.*
lines.say: Now, he has said it is fine. Leaving would mean admitting... he was wrong.

lines.speaker: copycat
lines.text: My eyes are burning. Is nobody going to move?
lines.say: My eyes are burning! Is nobody going to move?

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.say: What do you think... he does?

lines.speaker: copycat
lines.text: They are all calm. I must be the one who is *wrong.*
lines.say: They are all calm... I must be the one, who is wrong.
